forum.title: STM32WB5MMG - cannot change device name/model
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @Adrian Chmiel,

Thanks for contacting us on the ST Community.

Please find the answer below:

To configure the default **ZCL Basic Server** attributes, you need to meet the **ZCL data format** used by `ZbZclBasicServerDefaults` — in particular, string attributes are encoded as **length-prefixed strings** rather than standard null-terminated C strings.

As an example, you can refer to the following project available on the official Git:

[STM32CubeWBA/Projects/NUCLEO-WBA55CG/Applications/Zigbee/Zigbee\_OnOff\_Client\_SED/STM32\_WPAN/App/app\_zigbee.c at main · STMicroelectronics/STM32CubeWBA · GitHub](https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/STM32CubeWBA/blob/main/Projects/NUCLEO-WBA55CG/Applications/Zigbee/Zigbee_OnOff_Client_SED/STM32_WPAN/App/app_zigbee.c#L146)

Regards,

Ouadi
